hints.title: Distinct Request Acceptance Ratio
hints.text: Count unique sender-receiver acceptance pairs and divide by the count of unique sender-receiver request pairs.

hints.title: Safe Division and Zero Handling
hints.text: Retrieve distinct counts from both tables. Use ifnull or coalesce to return 0.00 if the total number of distinct friend requests is zero.

hints.title: Acceptance Rate Blueprint
hints.text: Select round(ifnull(count(distinct requester_id, accepter_id) / nullif(count(distinct sender_id, send_to_id), 0), 0.0), 2) as accept_rate from RequestAccepted, FriendRequest.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        IFNULL(
            (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT requester_id, accepter_id) FROM RequestAccepted) /
            NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sender_id, send_to_id) FROM FriendRequest), 0),
            0.0
        ),
        2
    ) AS accept_rate;
```

complexity.notes: Distinct pair hashing executes in linear time across both input tables.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Cross joining raw tables without distinct subqueries produces Cartesian row multiplication.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Independent scalar subqueries isolate distinct pair counts with minimal memory footprint.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Using NULLIF to guard against division by zero and returning 0.00 on empty tables.
